subject: Next steps: HIPAA requirements & recommended deployment for MediPrime
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo recap + HIPAA path options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Hi Taylor — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and the options we discussed so your security team can weigh in:

1) Summary of needs you called out
- PHI in prompts and model responses (claims data + limited patient identifiers)
- Annual third-party audits, and the need for audit logs retained for 7 years
- Contractual requirement for a Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
- Preference for data residency within us-east-1

2) Deployment modes we reviewed
- Hosted API: fastest to production, Redwood-managed keys, we can scope a HIPAA BAA and SOC2 evidence provided, but data flows through our multi-tenant control plane.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools for MediPrime with data isolation and dedicated network peering; better for throughput and isolation, still operated by Redwood but tenant-isolated.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): deploy Redwood Private control plane in your VPC or on-prem; best for strict regulatory controls and air-gapped workflows — higher lead time and licensing.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Can you confirm whether MediPrime requires on-prem air-gap, or would a VPC-hosted Private deployment suffice?
- Please share the security questionnaire (we saw a few items today) — we’ll return answers + evidence within 3 business days.
- I attached our latest SOC2 report and a draft BAA for your legal to review.

Suggested owners
- I’ll own coordination and the deal (Laura). Ben will scope Dedicated sizing and POC (Ben). Marissa (cc) will drive legal/BAA review.

Thanks — I can be available for a short follow-up with your security folks tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Best,
Laura Bennett

Laura — thanks for the clear notes. A few clarifications from our side after an internal sync: 

- Short answer on deployment: we prefer VPC-hosted Private deployment if it meets all audit evidence needs because our security team is strict about PHI egress. On-prem is still being considered but would be later in the project roadmap.
- We need to confirm that audit logs (access, model prompts, and admin actions) are exportable to our SIEM and retained for 7 years.
- SOC2 report is helpful. Please confirm which Trust Services Criteria are covered (security, availability, confidentiality).
- We’ll send a vendor security questionnaire (attached) — primary focus areas are key management, logging, data deletion, and incident response.

Can Ben be on the call next week to discuss architecture? Also, what lead time should we expect for a VPC Private deployment (estimate in weeks)?

Thanks,

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 13:46:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + HIPAA path options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Rajesh / Taylor — great questions, answered inline below. I'll also schedule a 30m architecture sync for next Tue; Laura, can you confirm availability?

- Trust Services Criteria: our SOC2 Type II (attached) covers Security and Availability; Confidentiality and Processing Integrity are scoped in the report — I noted pages with relevant controls and will mark them in the returned questionnaire.
- Audit logs: In Redwood Private (VPC) we surface detailed audit trails for admin actions, per-request metadata (request IDs, timestamps, model variant, route), and we can stream logs to your SIEM via an encrypted syslog/HTTPS forwarder. We can set retention via your bucket lifecycle policy to meet 7-year retention — recommended pattern is encrypted S3 in us-east-1 with bucket lock.
- Key management: For Private we support customer KMS (AWS KMS) or external HSM. For Dedicated we can offer a bring-your-own-KMS integration for encryption at rest. Hosted API uses Redwood-managed KMS unless customer KMS is contracted as an add-on.
- Lead times: VPC Private deployment (initial sandbox VPC) ~4–6 weeks for our standard onboarding (network setup, IAM, config, validation). On-prem full air-gapped packaging is typically 8–12+ weeks depending on change control. Dedicated capacity (Redwood-managed) ~2–3 weeks for reserved pool provisioning.

Next steps proposed
1) Laura: share annotated SOC2 and the draft BAA (done).
2) MediPrime: confirm must-have items on the questionnaire (Rajesh), then redwood to return a completed questionnaire with evidence linked to doc pages (target 3 business days after receipt).
3) If VPC Private is the path, we’ll kick off a network readiness call; Ben to own architecture and initial sizing POC.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
